points: Each machine has its own operating window, and the window of a compressor-drive turbine moves with the process.
An effective limit has to account for machine type, load range, and the GHG impact.

options.text: Set limits by driver type (generator vs mechanical drive).
Define the load range a limit applies to (not only base load) and the averaging time.
Evaluate NOx and GHG together as one inventory.
Continuous monitoring (CEMS) on variable-load units to build data.
